Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wC-049) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim backend was run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's GymnasiumDriver/family-config shape cannot express this upstream. ClutteredPushGrasp has no action_space, no observation_space, no env_id and no gymnasium.make registration (env.py:19-23 and :81-97); a GymnasiumDriver derives the contract from spaces the clone does not define. The package is therefore a direct Driver over the clone's entry class (native env:ClutteredPushGrasp) with the package fake. cap.world.step.v1 takes ticks plus a seven-element action object (x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw, gripper_opening_length) and calls step(action, 'end') (main.py:30); the envelope is the clone's own debug sliders (env.py:40-46). cap.world.reset.v1 calls reset and records a supplied seed only (the scene has no RNG; reset is fixed at robot.py:86-108 and env.py:127-134); the required seed output defaults to 0. cap.world.seed.v1 is deliberately not bound because the upstream has no seed method or RNG. NOT COVERED: joint-position control mode (a1..a6, gripper) because the clone states no joint range for it; the camera rgb/depth/seg arrays (no array size or unit is declared; the open observation object passes them through); snapshot and restore (no get_state/set_state); the PyBullet contact, IK, gravity, box-button and reward dynamics in the fake (the fake is a pure Python stand-in and was not compared with the upstream environment); the PyBullet physics time step (the clone states none, so fidelity timestep_ms is 0 and one tick is one 120-iteration ClutteredPushGrasp.step call, env.py:91). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning and no other gate warning remains. Only catalogue classes are bound, so there are no catalogue requests and no extension ids. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
